messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The Minor Power Desk printer spits out a yellow assignment slip.

Gina Park stamps it twice, sighs once, and hands it over.

(Gina Park) "Congratulations. Your public-service assignment is a traffic cone situation. Please do not make it a weather event."
